segments.name: nav_to_billing_documents

inputParameters.name: portal_url
inputParameters.description: Base URL of the Hangar Supply vendor portal

segments.deterministic: async (page, parameters) => { const baseUrl = String(parameters.portal_url || '').replace(/\/+$/, ''); await page.goto(`${baseUrl}/billing/documents`); return {}; }

segments.name: extract_billing_documents
segments.prompt: Check the page state. If the page shows a sign-in form instead of documents, stop and fail with the error message "signed out". Otherwise, on the Documents page with heading "Documents", read every item in the list labelled "Billing documents". Extract and return invoices_json: a JSON array with one object per list item, newest first, each with: number (e.g. HS-10480), issued (YYYY-MM-DD), due (YYYY-MM-DD), description (without Issued/Due/bullet separators), amount (without USD, spaces, or commas, formatted with two decimals), currency ("USD"), and status (Due mapped to "open", Past due mapped to "overdue", Settled mapped to "paid").

outputParameters.name: invoices_json
outputParameters.description: JSON array string containing invoice objects
